name: Custom Threads
description: SolidCraft plugin for smooth, exact B-rep custom threads with arbitrary sizes, flank angles, clearances, multi-start leads, collapsed timeline folders, and live parameters.

face.title: Cylindrical face
face.description: Pick a cylindrical shaft or hole face (optional if already selected).

mode.title: Thread Type
mode.description: Auto-detect shaft vs. hole, or force external/internal.

param_prefix.title: Parameter Prefix
param_prefix.description: Live User Parameter prefix (blank = automatic t1, t2, ...).

pitch.title: Pitch (mm)
pitch.description: Axial distance between adjacent thread crests.

length.title: Thread Length (mm)
length.description: Threaded length along axis (0 or blank threads full face).

starts.title: Starts
starts.description: Number of thread starts (lead = starts x pitch).

upper_flank_angle_deg.title: Upper Flank Angle (deg)
upper_flank_angle_deg.description: Upper flank from horizontal (45 prints support-free; 30 = ISO 60).

lower_flank_angle_deg.title: Lower Flank Angle (deg)
lower_flank_angle_deg.description: Lower flank from horizontal (vary for buttress threads).

radial_clearance.title: Radial Clearance (mm)
radial_clearance.description: Per-side radial offset for FDM fit.

axial_clearance.title: Axial Backlash (mm)
axial_clearance.description: Extra axial groove widening for smooth engagement.

crest_flat.title: Crest Flat (mm)
crest_flat.description: Flat width at tooth tip (keep >= nozzle width).

root_flat.title: Root Flat (mm)
root_flat.description: Flat width at tooth valley bottom.

crest_fillet.title: Crest Fillet (mm)
crest_fillet.description: Optional corner fillet on crests (0 disables).

root_fillet.title: Root Fillet (mm)
root_fillet.description: Optional corner fillet on roots (0 disables).

end_chamfer.title: End Chamfer
end_chamfer.description: Revolved lead-in/lead-out chamfer on free ends.

apply_clearance_to_external.title: Apply Clearance to External
apply_clearance_to_external.description: If true on shaft, shrinks shaft groove instead of expecting clearance on nut.

generate.title: Generate
generate.description: Create mating bolt + nut pair, or one part.

param_prefix.title: Parameter Prefix
param_prefix.description: Live User Parameter prefix (blank = automatic t1, t2, ...).

pitch.title: Pitch (mm)
pitch.description: Axial distance between adjacent thread crests.

starts.title: Starts
starts.description: Number of thread starts (lead = starts x pitch).

upper_flank_angle_deg.title: Upper Flank Angle (deg)
upper_flank_angle_deg.description: Upper flank from horizontal (45 prints support-free; 30 = ISO 60).

lower_flank_angle_deg.title: Lower Flank Angle (deg)
lower_flank_angle_deg.description: Lower flank from horizontal (vary for buttress threads).

radial_clearance.title: Radial Clearance (mm)
radial_clearance.description: Per-side radial clearance on nut relative to bolt.

axial_clearance.title: Axial Backlash (mm)
axial_clearance.description: Extra axial clearance in nut groove.

crest_fillet.title: Crest Fillet (mm)
crest_fillet.description: Optional corner fillet on crests (0 disables).

root_fillet.title: Root Fillet (mm)
root_fillet.description: Optional corner fillet on roots (0 disables).

nut_wall_thickness.title: Nut Wall Thickness (mm)
nut_wall_thickness.description: Radial wall outside nut thread major radius.

target.title: Target Thread (optional)
target.description: Pick any face or body of the thread to edit (optional).

param_prefix.title: Parameter Prefix
param_prefix.description: Prefix to edit (e.g. t1; blank = picked or latest thread).

major_diameter.title: Major Diameter (mm)
major_diameter.description: New major diameter (Pair/Bolt/Nut; blank keeps current).

upper_flank_angle_deg.title: Upper Flank Angle (deg)
upper_flank_angle_deg.description: New upper flank angle (blank keeps current).

lower_flank_angle_deg.title: Lower Flank Angle (deg)
lower_flank_angle_deg.description: New lower flank angle (blank keeps current).

crest_fillet.title: Crest Fillet (mm)
crest_fillet.description: New crest fillet (only if created > 0; blank keeps current).

root_fillet.title: Root Fillet (mm)
root_fillet.description: New root fillet (only if created > 0; blank keeps current).

end_chamfer.title: End Chamfer
end_chamfer.description: Enable or suppress revolved end chamfers.

nut_wall_thickness.title: Nut Wall Thickness (mm)
nut_wall_thickness.description: New Nut wall thickness (blank keeps current).
